invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any collision between fixed meta-training world seeds and the runner-random scoring seed.
Invalidate if an implementable candidate receives latent codes, sensor weights, label permutations, hidden targets or unprobed sensor values.
Invalidate unless every sensor access passes through the charged single-use probe interface.
Invalidate if the three source-identical causal roles differ outside meta-world access and preregistered representation learning versus freezing.
Invalidate unless the three v2 decision-DAG roles resolve to one implementation and frozen constants, differing only in the preregistered meta, support-only or frozen partition-policy source.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, external model or API use, state-budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.

alternative_explanations: The compiled tree itself, rather than meta-learned utility, may provide all query savings; frozen or support-only roles would then match shared.
Median binary splits may lose robustness under observation noise even when margin weighting transfers.
confounds: The local visible synthetic Gaussian generator favors adaptive Gaussian likelihood and high-budget cells may saturate; this scout cannot establish real perception or general intelligence.
falsification_criteria: Discard unless shared aggregate accuracy exceeds both source-identical ablations by at least 0.03.
Discard unless shared accuracy is within 0.01 of the stronger matched-probe Gaussian or kernel control and no cell is more than 0.03125 below both source-identical ablations.
Discard unless shared mean query operations are at least four times lower than both adaptive Gaussian and kernel controls and shared R16 workload is lower than both.
Discard if shared is absent from the implementable Pareto frontier or a simpler complete baseline matches its capability with no greater full cost.

outcome_policy.negative: If quality or full-cost gates fail, discard and falsify this exact decision-DAG rule without changing features, ridge, depth, leaf or stopping rules.
outcome_policy.null: If frozen or support-only utility matches shared, retain compiled decision traversal only as a classical engineering control and falsify the transfer claim without tuning.
outcome_policy.positive: Retain HYP-0043 as testing and authorize only unchanged multi-seed replication; do not promote.

predicted_outcome: Shared utility should learn to favor robust balanced margins, exceed both source-identical ablations by at least 0.03 accuracy, stay within 0.01 of the stronger matched-probe Gaussian or kernel control, and reduce mean query work by at least fourfold; early singleton leaves should reduce probes for small K. The stronger null is that two learned invariant weights match the fixed or support-only utility and add acquisition cost.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; a positive may only authorize an unchanged three-seed adversarial replication if every quality, ablation, cost, source-identity and Pareto gate passes.
research_question: Can a relabeling-invariant split utility learned across raw sensor worlds compile lower-work adaptive decision traversal while preserving matched held-out identification quality?
title: Compiled posterior-partition decision graph scout
